about: A companion container that backs up Minecraft server worlds on a schedule.

prs.title: Count pruning no longer deletes the newest backup
prs.broken: With tar backups and a "latest" link, pruning by count also counted the link. Keeping one backup deleted the archive just written, leaving no backup at all.
prs.changed: Pruning now skips the link and counts only real archives.
prs.matters: Minecraft servers keep the number of backups they asked for.
